items.summary: Contribution-margin disposition: site scorecards that show negative AI-cost margin are incomplete, not final contribution margins, because they omit infrastructure, domain, labor, and other costs and rely on zero site-attributed revenue while $4.92 aggregate revenue remains unassigned. Budget exposure is also unknown because monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and spending limit are blank. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned cost ledger covering AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, and marketing, reconciled to attributable cash revenue and outstanding commitments.

Retain the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation only. Do not create duplicate finance work or request telemetry already present. The existing reconciliation must preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed, reconcile only matching-period costs, and explicitly report unknown margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn. Escalate unresolved financial evidence gaps through the existing executive path; no owner decision is needed to continue this report-only work.
